mcq.QUESTION_DESC: Which of the following demonstrates encapsulation in Java?

sq.ANSWER:
Abstraction is the process of hiding internal details and showing only essential features to the user. It's implemented using abstract classes or interfaces.
Encapsulation is the process of wrapping data and methods that operate on the data into a single unit (class), and restricting direct access using private members and public getters/setters.
